---
format: pptx
params:
  export_json: ""
  vision: "complet"
---

```{r setup, include=FALSE}
knitr::opts_chunk$set(echo = FALSE)
source("_export_helpers.R")
sujet <- jsonlite::fromJSON(params$export_json, simplifyVector = FALSE)
```

```{r contenu, results='asis'}
pptx_first_slide(sujet$sujet)

for (q in sujet$questions) {
  cat("\n\n## ", esc_md(q$enonce), "\n\n")
  pptx_question_slide(q$propositions, corrige = FALSE)

  cat("\n\n## ", esc_md(q$enonce), "\n\n")
  pptx_question_slide(q$propositions, corrige = TRUE)
}
```
